Author: OmegaJackie
Name: Relicable
Changelog:
1.5.5.8 - everything since 1.5.4.5. Mostly getting unstuck:

Getting stuck: an aggro watchdog now runs for EVERY step rather than only the fighting ones, so a mob that lands on you while travelling, waiting or staging gets fought back instead of ignored - and 'aggroed' is read from the enmity table rather than from where a mob happens to be looking. Standing on the spot against an enemy you have no line to (usually one above or below you) now re-paths to a spot that actually has the shot, and gives up on it after fifteen seconds instead of shuffling for ever. Escort leves walk in long legs instead of stop-starting every few yalms. Leve objective points that sit under the floor are lifted onto it, which used to strand the run jittering underground.

Teleporting: the step now stands still while it casts (movement cancels it, and nothing was stopping the character), asks the game whether Teleport can be used before firing it rather than firing blind, waits out combat instead of failing, and retries in seconds rather than three quarters of a minute. Failures say what it would have cost and what you are carrying.

Dying: death recovery no longer mistakes the Return teleport for the resurrection - it used to decide you were alive 97 milliseconds after pressing Return, resume, find itself still dead, and loop. It also says why it is stuck instead of retrying silently. And in a FATE that is going badly, it now drops level sync below 10% health and lives, rather than dying for one FATE's credit - unless the enemy is going to die first.

Books: finishing your ninth book now goes to Jalzahn for the enhancement instead of buying book 1 again for 500 poetics and regrinding all nine. New /relic booksdone tells it the books are finished when it has no record of its own.

Also: optional auto-discard of mob drops so a long unattended run stops filling its bags (off by default, Configuration - Inventory, with a live list of exactly what would go), and a book FATE you cleared yourself is no longer written off as someone else's.
Punchline: Automate the ARR Zodiac relic line
Description:
Data-driven automation engine for the ARR Zodiac relic line (A Relic Reborn through Zodiac Zeta). It plans and drives the stage objectives - Atma FATE farming, Animus book leves and dungeons, Novus materia/scroll planning, Nexus light farming, and the Jalzahn/Gerolt upgrade turn-ins - by orchestrating other plugins over IPC rather than replacing them.

Requires these companion plugins, installed and working: vnavmesh (movement), BossMod Reborn, Rotation Solver Reborn or Wrath Combo (combat), Lifestream (aetheryte travel), TextAdvance (dialogue), and AutoDuty (dungeons). The Dependencies tab in /relic config shows live status for each.

USE AT YOUR OWN RISK: automating movement and combat is botting under the FINAL FANTASY XIV User Agreement, and Square Enix suspends and terminates accounts for it. The risk is highest for the open-world stages (Atma, Animus, Nexus, Zeta), which run in shared content where other players can observe and report you. Neither this plugin nor its authors can reduce that risk or protect you from it.

This software takes control of your character for long unattended sessions. It is incomplete, it has rough edges, and stages will occasionally stall and need manual help. Do not run it unattended if that is not acceptable to you. Bug reports should include /xllog output with 'Enable debug log' turned on in /relic config.

Author: OmegaJackie
Name: CineSync
Punchline: Self-hosted synced in-world media screens for movie nights.
Description: Host a small server; paired friends connect and automatically see the in-world screens (TVs) you create, all playing the same media. Move/resize/rotate gizmo, LibVLC video, auto-reconnect. Pairs with a self-hosted Owncast stream.
Changelog: Depth occlusion: screens now draw as real world geometry depth-tested against the game scene, so characters, walls and props in front of a screen correctly hide it instead of being painted over. Toggle it under Rendering, or /cinesync flat; falls back to the old flat overlay automatically if it cannot start.

Author: Infi, kalilistic
Name: PlayerTrack
Description:
PlayerTrack helps you keep a record of who you meet and the content you played together.
Organize players into categories, keep notes, and track them across name/world changes.
Customization options include colors, icons, nameplates, and alerts.
Punchline: Keep track of players you meet.
Changelog: Fork of Infiziert90/PlayerTrack with an IPC surface for other plugins.

Author: twelvehouse
Name: ChatAnywhere
Description:
Features:
- Real-time chat streaming via Server-Sent Events
- Supports all channel types: FC, LS/CWLS 1-8, Party, Tell, Say, Shout, Yell, Alliance, and more
- Custom filters with drag-and-drop reordering, unread badges, and default send channels
- Tell mode with pin support and recent DM history
- Send queue: brief countdown after pressing Send so you can cancel accidental sends (opt-in)
- Emote picker with search and recently used, and FFXIV symbol picker
- Link previews for trusted sites (Lodestone, YouTube, Twitter/X, Twitch, and more)
- Appearance customisation: Light and Dark themes, Google Fonts, font size, coloured message backgrounds
- Passcode authentication for browser access
Punchline: Host your chat on a web server so you can talk from anywhere.

Author: Bozja Buddy Reborn contributors
Name: Bozja Buddy Reborn
Description: Reads live Bozja/Zadnor field-operation state (mettle, resistance rank, Lost Action holster, Critical Engagement phases) and orchestrates vnavmesh for movement, BossMod Reborn for AoE avoidance and Rotation Solver Reborn for rotations. Includes multibox coordination across game clients and Resistance relic progress tracking.
Punchline: Orchestrate Critical Engagements on the Bozjan Southern Front and Zadnor

Author: Jackie
Name: Line Me Up
Description: Walks your character onto the spot a target is standing on, then turns you to face the same way they do. Movement is real: your character walks there under its own power, easing off speed on the final approach so it settles on the mark rather than overshooting it. Supports a target-relative offset, a facing offset, and a continuous follow mode that keeps you on their mark as they move. Built for lining up at close quarters - there is no pathfinding.
Punchline: Walk onto your target's spot and match the way they're facing.

Author: Jackie
Name: SellJunk
Description: Flags inventory items as junk when they are re-buyable from an NPC vendor under a gil threshold AND are either low-level/untimed gathering node drops or only used in below-max-level crafts. Sells them to any open shop on a single confirmed click, and retrieves matching junk out of your retainers at a summoning bell.
Punchline: One click to clear vendor-replaceable clutter out of your bags

Author: Jackie
Name: AutoFATE
Description: Standalone rebuild of the Date With Destiny / Fate Tool Kit module from ffxiv-bundleoftweaks. Combat rotation by Rotation Solver Reborn, AoE avoidance and targeting by BossMod (Reborn), pathing by vnavmesh. Requires vnavmesh, BossMod Reborn, Rotation Solver Reborn, and TextAdvance.
Punchline: Automated FATE grinding — RSR fights, BossMod dodges, vnavmesh walks.
Changelog: Standalone rebuild of the Date With Destiny / Fate Tool Kit module from Jaksuhn/ffxiv-bundleoftweaks (BSD 3-Clause). Requires vnavmesh, BossMod Reborn, Rotation Solver Reborn and TextAdvance.
